basis: Explicit recorder-role self-report in original client RTSP DESCRIBE messages. Preserve unknown model. Vendor-only, generic desktop players, opposite endpoint and wrong protocol are excluded. This is a reviewed field-evidence rule, not an imported upstream signature.
